Optional spatial research uses Google ARCore SDK 1.57.0.
The SDK's published POM identifies the ARCore Additional Terms of Service:
https://developers.google.com/ar/develop/terms
Google API Terms: https://developers.google.com/terms/
Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
User privacy requirements: https://developers.google.com/ar/develop/privacy-requirements
Google Play Services for AR may need installation or updates on supported devices.
Cloud Anchors and Geospatial APIs are disabled in this application.
The renderer and recorder in this project are original application code.
